status: robot-adapted manual crank design; not a catalog vise or hardware-validated mechanism

pedestal.collision_proposal: Add one fixed support under the entire lifted vise in the new task; no alteration of powered task.

lead_screw.arrangement: Axially fixed rotating screw in two fixed thrust-bearing supports; anti-rotation nut translates with jaw on two guide rails.
lead_screw.positive_rotation: Positive right-hand rotation about +Y increases jaw opening; negative closes. Match CAD helix handedness in engine convention before use.
lead_screw.backlash_status: Explicit modelling proposal; not represented by CAD clearance as a validated tolerance

tray_layout_revision.reason: Original output tray overlapped the CAD pedestal12 mm in X and design-scene collision pedestal15 mm. Move only this empty tray in the new manual task; robot, stock, jaw and crank poses remain unchanged.
tray_layout_revision.required_scene_update: Set new manual output_tray body pos=.18 .10 0; do not alter frozen powered scene.

support_table.contact_status: Visual CAD only; new task must provide matching fixed support collisions.

handle.bearing: Passive free-spinning grip sleeve on crank pin, no motor or weld to robot
handle.bearing_assumption: Low-friction sleeve bearing; numerical values are provisional and require sensitivity testing. Only radial/axial contact transmission, not commanded orientation tracking.
handle.note: Lowest surface includes 5 mm endcap radius; gripper envelope needs separate collision validation.

travel.stroke_protocol: Grasp the right-hand grip, rotate through the upper semicircle by pi radians in closing direction, release, then acquire the other grip now at the right. Repeat six times without reverse screw rotation, motor, ratchet or skipped turns.
travel.short_demo_condition: A near-clamp initial state must be explicitly declared; do not conceal omitted opening turns.

force_model_proposal.required_simulation: Apply contact-derived hand torque to shaft; constrain screw translation to zero and jaw rotation to zero. Use finite torque/friction, joint limits, finite contact stiffness and measured jaw forces. Do not motor the jaw or teleport angle/translation.
force_model_proposal.limitations: Square-thread formula is only a provisional estimate; CAD ridge is not a validated thread standard. Add bearing drag and calibrated friction before force claims. Self-locking is not guaranteed from CAD.

collision_authority: Original fixed stock/jaw contact faces from tasks/yam_machine_tending/scene.xml; new handle/nut/bridge collisions must be introduced and audited in a separate dual-arm task.
clearance_risks: Raised nut bridge near first gripper needs full articulated collision checks.
Second-arm base, wrist and all crank angles require reachability/collision checks.
CAD support/rod overlaps describe an assembled mechanism, not collision pairs.
powered_components: None: no motor, pneumatic barrel, service line or powered actuator in this CAD variant.
